ITEM 1 | Pale golden-tan granular mass, small grains about 2-3 mm, dry and crumbly with slight sheen, clumped in a mound roughly 7 cm by 6 cm at left-center of plate, scattered tiny crumbs around its edge, no visible sauce | 95
ITEM 2 | Bright green slender stalks, roughly 0.3-0.5 cm thick and 5-9 cm long, some with small leaf tufts, fairly firm and moist-looking, laid in a loose diagonal band across the center of the plate between the grain mound and the leafy greens | 45
ITEM 3 | Dark green finely curled ruffled leaves, crinkled and slightly glossy, with some paler pale-green pieces and small wilted bits, forming an irregular mound about 8 cm by 7 cm at right side of plate, a small dark brown fleck sits at its edge | 60
